title: Wavetable Weaver
description: Draw your own wavetables, morph between them live, and play through a real polyphonic synth with an arpeggiator and WAV export.
concept: An 8-slot wavetable synthesizer where every waveform is hand-drawn on a canvas or picked from quick shape presets. A morph slider crossfades continuously between adjacent slots in real time, feeding a polyphonic voice engine with ADSR, a resonant filter, delay/reverb sends, and an arpeggiator. Play with the on-screen piano, touch, or your computer keyboard, then render the current arp/chord loop straight to a downloadable WAV.
features: 8 drawable single-cycle wavetable slots with quick sine/tri/saw/square presets
Continuous morph slider crossfading between adjacent wavetable slots live
Polyphonic play via on-screen piano, touch, or QWERTY keyboard with octave shift
ADSR envelope, resonant low/high/band-pass filter, delay + reverb sends
Render current loop to a real downloadable WAV file
Save/load named presets plus autosave of the full patch to localStorage

interaction.mouse: Draw waveforms on the 8 canvases, drag sliders, click piano keys to play
interaction.click: Preset shape buttons, save/load preset, render loop to WAV
interaction.touch: Draw wavetables and play the piano with touch, tuned for mobile
interaction.keyboard: A W S E D F T G Y H U J K O L P play notes, Z/X shift octave
